name: HiDrive Cloud Codespace
onCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y rclone
postStartCommand: mkdir -p ~/workspace/hidrive-cloud && rclone config create hidrive webdav url=https://strato.com vendor=other user=$HIDRIVE_USER pass=$(rclone obscure $HIDRIVE_PASS) && rclone copy hidrive: ~/workspace/hidrive-cloud --progress
